clips.title: The story
paras: Outside Ratchet in the Barrens, Mupsi Shacklefridd helps travelers repair ties with the Steamwheedle Cartel.

Mupsi Shacklefridd works along the coastal road just outside Ratchet. Steamwheedle guards patrol the port town's edge as merchants come and go. Travelers on poor terms with the goblins can seek a way back into the cartel's good graces through Mupsi, if they bring the supplies and labor it demands.
